statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. A delayed NQ reference near 23:00 UTC stabilized above Tuesday's low and did not extend the earlier reopen decline, so current evidence does not show persistent one-way structure or a verified failed-retracement sequence.
recommendation: Published policy mapping: EA_ON. Tail remains below the WATCH threshold while the reopen move lacks confirmed repeated extension; the next concentrated checkpoint is Wednesday's cash-open and Employer Costs window.
headline: Reopen stabilization returns Tail to low while macro Stress stays extreme
body: Delayed NQ was 29,525.75 at 22:59:59 UTC, about 101 points above Tuesday's 29,424.75 session low. Fresh shared context showed six of eight tracked megacaps lower but five of seven tracked semiconductors higher, a conflicted backdrop rather than uniform technology direction. Oil and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme.

sources.title: Reuters — Oil prices hit six-week high after Houthis attack Saudi sites

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 32%. The 32% peak occurred during Tuesday's 14:00 UTC cash-open downside extension; later repair returned Tail below the blocking band while Stress stayed extreme.
outlookSummary: The overnight baseline is low Tail if two-sided rotation persists. WATCH risk concentrates around Wednesday 13:20-15:30 UTC, covering the cash-open transition and Employer Costs release, with a separate Apple-event checkpoint at 17:00 UTC.

forecast.analysis: A delayed NQ reference at 22:59:59 UTC was 29,525.75, about 101 points above Tuesday's session low. The reopen decline has not extended to a fresh low or produced a verified sequence of failed retracements, so Tail returns to the low band while macro Stress remains extreme.

forecast.analysis: If overnight trading remains two-sided around the reopened range, Tail stays low. A renewed break that holds near an overnight extreme with weak counter-moves would be the principal escalation path.

The Asia handoff remains low Tail provided counter-moves stay meaningful and directional efficiency does not increase. Geopolitical headlines remain primarily a Stress amplifier unless price structure confirms persistence.
Early Asia remains low Tail if pullbacks and reversals continue to interrupt direction. Repeated extension after shallow counter-moves would be the key adverse condition for this hour.
Mid-Asia keeps a low-Tail baseline. Risk would rise if NQ holds near an overnight extreme while attempted retracements repeatedly fail and cross-asset pressure becomes more aligned.

Late Asia remains low Tail if price rotates through prior levels rather than carrying an efficient one-way move toward Europe. Persistent overnight direction without repair would challenge this baseline.
The Asia-to-Europe transition stays low Tail if price discovery remains two-sided. A clean handoff of an overnight directional move into Europe would be the main conditional escalation signal.

Early Europe remains low Tail unless the overnight move begins to accelerate with shallow repairs. Conflicted technology breadth argues against assuming uniform index direction before U.S. liquidity returns.

European morning conditions remain low Tail if NQ continues to rotate rather than hold an extreme. Fresh directional alignment across yields, oil and technology would be required for a materially higher path.
As Europe advances, Tail remains low under an orderly-range assumption. A persistent directional build into the U.S. premarket would raise the importance of the later cash-open checkpoint.
The U.S. premarket remains low Tail if overnight structure is still two-sided. Increasing directional efficiency ahead of New York would lift sensitivity to the scheduled Employer Costs release.
Late premarket conditions sit near the WATCH boundary because U.S. liquidity is approaching. Tail stays low if gaps and early impulses retain meaningful repair ahead of the cash session.

WATCH begins as the market approaches the U.S. cash open. A large opening gap alone is insufficient for higher Tail; persistent extension with shallow or failed retracements would be the adverse confirmation.
The cash-open transition is a WATCH window. Tail rises conditionally if the opening auction establishes one-way structure that holds near an extreme; early two-sided repair would weaken that path.

Employer Costs are scheduled for 14:00 UTC during the active cash session. Tail is at the top of WATCH conditionally; only persistent post-release repricing with failed repair would justify a blocking-band path.

The hour after Employer Costs remains WATCH for a possible second leg. Tail would stay elevated only if the initial move persists, counter-moves remain shallow and cross-assets reinforce the same direction.

Post-event digestion remains WATCH but should ease if the market rotates through the release impulse. A continued hold near a session extreme with repeated extension would keep the adverse path active.

Apple's scheduled 17:00 UTC event creates a separate WATCH checkpoint. Tail rises only conditionally if index-heavy technology reprices persistently and broader Nasdaq structure confirms a one-way move.

The first hour after the Apple event remains WATCH for conditional follow-through. Two-sided price discovery and sector offset would lower Tail; broad persistent technology repricing would keep it elevated.
Later cash-session risk returns to low if event impulses have repaired and the index is no longer holding an extreme. A renewed directional push into the close would be the main reason to reassess.
The cash-close transition remains low Tail if the day finishes with balanced repair. A close pinned near an extreme after failed counter-moves would preserve more overnight path risk.

Post-cash conditions remain low Tail absent a fresh catalyst-driven gap. Reduced liquidity can amplify headlines, but Tail requires evidence that any move persists rather than merely expands volatility.
The pre-reopen interval keeps a low baseline if no new discontinuity emerges. Any fresh geopolitical or corporate shock would need price-path confirmation before materially changing Tail.
The next Globex reopen stays low Tail under the baseline scenario. A new gap that extends without meaningful repair would be the principal condition for moving back into WATCH or above.
